truth.description: The css-post plugin now reads the html proxy index with /&inline-css&index=(\d+)/ and throws when it does not match, but the dev html middleware transforms each style attribute under the module id it holds, which ends in ?html-proxy&inline-css&style-attr&index=N.css, as does the import the build html plugin emits, so any page with a url() in a style attribute fails to load in dev and fails to build.

distractions.why: Both places that build a worker file URL inject worker_file&type=<type> as one string through injectQuery, which only prepends whole queries, so the two keys always stay adjacent and in that order.
